data.exact_reserve_text:
Favourable runoff experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes

Strengthening of Political Risk reserves as a consequence of specific adverse experience and a reevaluation of reserves in the light of the deterioration in global economic conditions which occurred during 2020.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small net prioryear release of approximately GBP 0.82m (0.71% of opening gross reserves) for underwriting years up to 2018. This net release reflected mixed development across years - releases on 2016 and 2018 more than offset adverse development on 2015 and 2017 - with overall favourable runoff across most classes. Political Risk and Directors & Officers reserves strengthened due to specific adverse experience and deterioration in global economic conditions during 2020. Reinsurance restructures were used to protect the 2020 underwriting result.

data.data_quality_notes: Prioryear development was not provided as a single gross figure; it was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) for underwriting years 2015-2018. Confidence rated 0.8 for the computed PYD. LOB mapping: 'Credit and suretyship' was mapped to 'Professional Lines' for reporting purposes (approximate). Lob movements computed by comparing gross outstanding claims by LOB at 31/12/2019 vs 31/12/2020 from the concentration table.
